nodes.name: Communication & Information Occupations
nodes.description: Obsolete occupations centred on transmitting, announcing and delivering information before electronic media.

nodes.name: Telegraph Operator
nodes.description: Operated an electrical telegraph, sending and receiving Morse-coded messages over land lines.

nodes.name: Morse Operator
nodes.description: Specialized in sending and receiving International Morse code at commercial speed.

nodes.name: Submarine Cable Operator
nodes.description: Worked the sensitive galvanometer instruments of an overseas telegraph cable station.

nodes.name: Switchboard Operator
nodes.description: Manually connected telephone calls by plugging cords into a switchboard jack field.

nodes.name: Town Crier
nodes.description: Publicly announced proclamations, news and court orders by ringing a bell and crying in the street.

nodes.name: Herald
nodes.description: Delivered royal and noble proclamations and oversaw ceremonial and armorial affairs.

nodes.name: Courier
nodes.description: Carried dispatches and letters over long distances on foot or horseback before regular postal service.

nodes.name: Post Rider
nodes.description: Rode a fixed relay route carrying official mail, changing horses at posting stations.

nodes.name: Semaphore Operator
nodes.description: Transmitted messages by positioning the arms of a semaphore tower or flag.

nodes.name: Heliograph Operator
nodes.description: Signalled with flashes of reflected sunlight using a heliograph mirror.

nodes.name: Flag Signalman
nodes.description: Conveyed tactical and railway messages using hand-held signal flags.

nodes.name: News Crier
nodes.description: Shouted headlines and hawked newspapers or broadsides in the street.

nodes.name: Carrier Pigeon Keeper
nodes.description: Bred, trained and dispatched homing pigeons for message delivery.

nodes.name: Telegram Messenger
nodes.description: Delivered telegrams on foot or bicycle from the telegraph office to recipients.

nodes.name: Wireless Operator
nodes.description: Operated early spark-gap radio equipment to send and receive Morse by electromagnetic waves.

nodes.name: Lector
nodes.description: Read aloud newspapers, literature and political texts to workers while they laboured, notably in cigar factories.

nodes.name: Scribal & Documentary Occupations
nodes.description: Obsolete occupations of writing, copying and decorating documents by hand.

nodes.name: Scribe
nodes.description: Wrote and copied documents by hand as a professional penman.

nodes.name: Manuscript Scribe
nodes.description: Copied literary and religious manuscripts by hand in a scriptorium.

nodes.name: Legal Scribe
nodes.description: Drafted deeds, contracts and legal instruments by hand.

nodes.name: Temple Scribe
nodes.description: Kept temple records and sacred texts in ancient Egypt and Mesopotamia.

nodes.name: Court Scribe
nodes.description: Recorded decrees and archives for an imperial or royal court.

nodes.name: Illuminator
nodes.description: Decorated manuscripts with gold leaf, pigments and painted initials.

nodes.name: Miniaturist
nodes.description: Painted small detailed illustrations and portraits within manuscripts.

nodes.name: Rubricator
nodes.description: Drew red initials, headings and rubrics to structure a manuscript page.

nodes.name: Copyist
nodes.description: Reproduced texts and music by hand for distribution.

nodes.name: Scrivener
nodes.description: A professional copyist of legal and business documents.

nodes.name: Court Calligrapher
nodes.description: Produced official and artistic brush or pen writing for court documents.

nodes.name: Shorthand Writer
nodes.description: Recorded speech in abbreviated script for courts and parliaments.

nodes.name: Public Letter Writer
nodes.description: Composed and wrote letters for illiterate customers at a street stall.

nodes.name: Printing & Typesetting Occupations
nodes.description: Obsolete occupations of composing, printing and binding text and images by hand.

nodes.name: Typesetter
nodes.description: Composed movable type by hand for letterpress printing.

nodes.name: Hand Compositor
nodes.description: Set individual type characters by hand into a composing stick.

nodes.name: Linotype Operator
nodes.description: Cast whole lines of type on a hot-metal Linotype machine.

nodes.name: Monotype Operator
nodes.description: Cast individual characters on a keyboard-driven Monotype caster.

nodes.name: Hand Press Printer
nodes.description: Inked type and pulled impressions on a hand-operated printing press.

nodes.name: Woodcut Carver
nodes.description: Cut relief images into wood blocks for printing illustrations.

nodes.name: Copperplate Engraver
nodes.description: Incised images into copper plates for intaglio printing.

nodes.name: Lithographer
nodes.description: Drew and printed images from prepared limestone using lithography.

nodes.name: Electrotyper
nodes.description: Deposited copper onto wax moulds by electrolysis to make durable plates.

nodes.name: Hand Bookbinder
nodes.description: Sewed, glued and bound printed sheets into books by hand.

nodes.name: Craft & Manufacture Occupations
nodes.description: Pre-industrial handicraft occupations grouped by material and trade.

nodes.name: Woodworking Occupations
nodes.description: Handicrafts of shaping, joining and turning wood.

nodes.name: Cooper
nodes.description: Made and repaired wooden barrels, casks and buckets.

nodes.name: Tight Cooper
nodes.description: Made liquid-tight barrels for wine, beer and other wet goods.

nodes.name: Dry Cooper
nodes.description: Made barrels for dry goods such as flour and tobacco.

nodes.name: White Cooper
nodes.description: Made straight-sided household vessels such as pails and churns.

nodes.name: Wheelwright
nodes.description: Built and repaired wooden spoked wheels for carts and wagons.

nodes.name: Wainwright
nodes.description: Constructed horse-drawn wagons and carts.

nodes.name: Pit Sawyer
nodes.description: Cut logs into boards by hand using a two-man pit saw.

nodes.name: Clog Maker
nodes.description: Carved wooden-soled footwear.

nodes.name: Broom Squire
nodes.description: Made brooms and besoms from birch twigs and heather.

nodes.name: Fletcher
nodes.description: Made and fletched arrows with feathers.

nodes.name: Bowyer
nodes.description: Crafted longbows and other wooden bows.

nodes.name: Metalworking Occupations
nodes.description: Handicrafts of forging, casting and finishing metal.

nodes.name: Blacksmith
nodes.description: Forged and shaped iron and steel by heating and hammering.

nodes.name: Farrier
nodes.description: Shod horses and treated their hooves.

nodes.name: Whitesmith
nodes.description: Finished and polished tin and light metalwork, often tinning surfaces.

nodes.name: Tinsmith
nodes.description: Fabricated household wares from tinplate.

nodes.name: Tinker
nodes.description: An itinerant mender of metal pots and pans.

nodes.name: Coppersmith
nodes.description: Raised and soldered copper vessels and pipes.

nodes.name: Pewterer
nodes.description: Cast and finished pewter tableware.

nodes.name: Bell Founder
nodes.description: Cast church and town bells in bronze.

nodes.name: Nailer
nodes.description: Forged nails by hand at a hearth, often as domestic outwork.

nodes.name: Swordsmith
nodes.description: Forged, tempered and polished swords.

nodes.name: Katana Smith
nodes.description: Forged and folded Japanese katana blades.

nodes.name: Armourer
nodes.description: Forged and fitted plate and mail armour.

nodes.name: Gunsmith
nodes.description: Bored, rifled and stocked early firearms.

nodes.name: Clockmaker
nodes.description: Hand-made and repaired mechanical clocks.

nodes.name: Watchmaker
nodes.description: Assembled and regulated pocket watches by hand.

nodes.name: Leatherworking Occupations
nodes.description: Handicrafts of tanning, dressing and sewing leather.

nodes.name: Tanner
nodes.description: Converted raw hides into leather using tannins.

nodes.name: Currier
nodes.description: Dressed, softened and finished tanned leather.

nodes.name: Cordwainer
nodes.description: Made fine leather shoes from new leather.

nodes.name: Cobbler
nodes.description: Repaired worn shoes.

nodes.name: Saddler
nodes.description: Made and repaired saddles and horse harness.

nodes.name: Furrier
nodes.description: Dressed and sewed furs into garments.

nodes.name: Parchmenter
nodes.description: Prepared animal skins into writing parchment and vellum.

nodes.name: Stone, Glass & Ceramic Occupations
nodes.description: Handicrafts of working stone, glass and fired clay.

nodes.name: Stone Mason
nodes.description: Cut, dressed and set stone for buildings.

nodes.name: Stone Carver
nodes.description: Carved decorative and monumental stonework.

nodes.name: Glassblower
nodes.description: Blew and shaped molten glass into vessels.

nodes.name: Potter
nodes.description: Threw and fired clay vessels on a wheel.

nodes.name: Brickmaker
nodes.description: Moulded and fired clay bricks.

nodes.name: Lime Burner
nodes.description: Calcined limestone in kilns to produce quicklime.

nodes.name: Flint Knapper
nodes.description: Struck flint to make gun flints and cutting tools.

nodes.name: Fiber, Paper & Basketry Occupations
nodes.description: Handicrafts of weaving fiber, forming paper and making small wares.

nodes.name: Hand Papermaker
nodes.description: Formed sheets of paper from rag pulp on a mould and deckle.

nodes.name: Basket Maker
nodes.description: Wove willow, rush or cane into baskets.

nodes.name: Ropemaker
nodes.description: Laid and twisted hemp into rope on a ropewalk.

nodes.name: Thatcher
nodes.description: Thatched roofs with straw, reed or rushes.

nodes.name: Chandlery & Soap Occupations
nodes.description: Handicrafts of making candles, soap and lighting fats.

nodes.name: Candle Maker
nodes.description: Dipped and moulded candles for lighting.

nodes.name: Tallow Chandler
nodes.description: Rendered animal fat into tallow candles and soap.

nodes.name: Wax Chandler
nodes.description: Made beeswax and spermaceti candles.

nodes.name: Rushlight Maker
nodes.description: Dipped peeled rushes in fat to make cheap rushlights.

nodes.name: Soap Boiler
nodes.description: Boiled fats and lye to make soap.

nodes.name: Textile & Garment Occupations
nodes.description: Obsolete occupations of spinning, weaving, dyeing and sewing cloth and clothing.

nodes.name: Hand Spinner
nodes.description: Twisted fibres into yarn on a spindle or spinning wheel.

nodes.name: Handloom Weaver
nodes.description: Wove cloth on a hand or foot-treadle loom.

nodes.name: Fuller
nodes.description: Cleaned and thickened woollen cloth by treading or pounding in water.

nodes.name: Dyer
nodes.description: Coloured cloth and yarn with natural dyes.

nodes.name: Lace Maker
nodes.description: Worked bobbins or needles to make lace.

nodes.name: Embroiderer
nodes.description: Decorated fabric with needle and thread.

nodes.name: Tapestry Weaver
nodes.description: Wove pictorial hangings on a high-warp loom.

nodes.name: Hatter
nodes.description: Blocked and finished felt hats.

nodes.name: Milliner
nodes.description: Trimmed and sold women's hats and headwear.

nodes.name: Seamstress
nodes.description: Sewed garments by hand or on early machines.

nodes.name: Tailor
nodes.description: Cut and fitted bespoke garments by hand.

nodes.name: Dressmaker
nodes.description: Made women's gowns to measure.

nodes.name: Domestic & Personal Service Occupations
nodes.description: Obsolete occupations of service within households and to individuals.

nodes.name: Footman
nodes.description: Attended a carriage, waited at table and ran errands in livery.

nodes.name: Running Footman
nodes.description: Ran ahead of a carriage to announce its arrival and clear the way.

nodes.name: Valet
nodes.description: A gentleman's personal attendant, caring for clothes and grooming.

nodes.name: Lady's Maid
nodes.description: A lady's personal servant, dressing hair and wardrobe.

nodes.name: Scullery Maid
nodes.description: Washed dishes and scrubbed the kitchen as the lowest-ranked maid.

nodes.name: Kitchen Maid
nodes.description: Prepared ingredients and assisted the cook.

nodes.name: Chambermaid
nodes.description: Cleaned and maintained bedrooms in a great house or hotel.

nodes.name: Butler
nodes.description: Managed the wine cellar and male household staff.

nodes.name: Groom
nodes.description: Cared for horses and drove carriages as required.

nodes.name: Nursemaid
nodes.description: Cared for the children of the household.

nodes.name: Wet Nurse
nodes.description: Breastfed another woman's infant for pay.

nodes.name: Governess
nodes.description: Educated the children of a wealthy household.

nodes.name: Laundress
nodes.description: Washed and ironed household linen and clothes.

nodes.name: Punkah-Wallah
nodes.description: Pulled a ceiling fan (punkah) by rope to cool a room.

nodes.name: Food & Provisioning Occupations
nodes.description: Obsolete occupations of producing and vending food, drink and household provisions.

nodes.name: Ice Cutter
nodes.description: Sawed and harvested blocks of natural ice from frozen lakes.

nodes.name: Iceman
nodes.description: Delivered blocks of ice to homes and iceboxes.

nodes.name: Water Carrier
nodes.description: Carried and sold fresh water from wells or springs.

nodes.name: Milkmaid
nodes.description: Milked cows by hand and churned butter.

nodes.name: Dairymaid
nodes.description: Managed the dairy, making butter and cheese.

nodes.name: Milkman
nodes.description: Delivered fresh milk door to door by horse-drawn cart.

nodes.name: Baker
nodes.description: Kneaded and baked bread in a wood-fired oven.

nodes.name: Brewer
nodes.description: Brewed ale and beer by hand in small breweries.

nodes.name: Miller
nodes.description: Ground grain into flour at a water or wind mill.

nodes.name: Costermonger
nodes.description: Sold fruit and vegetables from a street barrow.

nodes.name: Peddler
nodes.description: Travelled selling small goods door to door.

nodes.name: Transport & Porterage Occupations
nodes.description: Obsolete occupations of carrying people and goods by human or animal power.

nodes.name: Sedan Bearer
nodes.description: Carried passengers in an enclosed sedan chair.

nodes.name: Palanquin Bearer
nodes.description: Bore a covered palanquin for wealthy or noble passengers.

nodes.name: Rickshaw Puller
nodes.description: Hauled a two-wheeled passenger cart on foot.

nodes.name: Litter Bearer
nodes.description: Carried the sick or wounded on a stretcher-like litter.

nodes.name: Stagecoach Driver
nodes.description: Drove a scheduled passenger coach over fixed routes.

nodes.name: Coachman
nodes.description: Drove a private horse-drawn carriage.

nodes.name: Postilion
nodes.description: Rode the near horse of a carriage team to guide it.

nodes.name: Wagoner
nodes.description: Drove heavy freight wagons overland.

nodes.name: Carter
nodes.description: Hauled goods by horse and cart for hire.

nodes.name: Drayman
nodes.description: Delivered beer and heavy barrels by dray.

nodes.name: Teamster
nodes.description: Drove a team of oxen or mules hauling freight.

nodes.name: Muleteer
nodes.description: Led pack mules over mountain trails.

nodes.name: Camel Driver
nodes.description: Led camel caravans across desert routes.

nodes.name: Packhorse Driver
nodes.description: Guided trains of loaded packhorses.

nodes.name: Ferryman
nodes.description: Poled or rowed passengers across rivers.

nodes.name: Maritime & Waterway Occupations
nodes.description: Obsolete occupations of working ships, coasts and inland waterways under sail and oar.

nodes.name: Whaler
nodes.description: Hunted whales from open boats for oil and baleen.

nodes.name: Harpooner
nodes.description: Cast the harpoon to fasten a whale.

nodes.name: Ship's Cooper
nodes.description: Made and repaired the barrels stowing a ship's provisions.

nodes.name: Ship Chandler
nodes.description: Supplied ships with provisions and nautical stores.

nodes.name: Sailmaker
nodes.description: Cut and sewed sails for square-rigged ships.

nodes.name: Ship Caulker
nodes.description: Drove oakum into plank seams and sealed them with pitch.

nodes.name: Oarsman
nodes.description: Rowed a galley or boat for propulsion.

nodes.name: Galley Slave
nodes.description: A convict or captive forced to row a war galley.

nodes.name: Powder Monkey
nodes.description: A boy who ferried gunpowder to a warship's guns.

nodes.name: Lamp Trimmer
nodes.description: Tended and refilled a ship's oil lamps and compass.

nodes.name: Lighthouse Keeper
nodes.description: Maintained the light and lived at an isolated lighthouse.

nodes.name: Lighterman
nodes.description: Transferred cargo between ship and shore in a lighter barge.

nodes.name: Bargeman
nodes.description: Worked a canal or river cargo barge.

nodes.name: Canal Boatman
nodes.description: Steered horse-drawn narrowboats on canals.

nodes.name: Agricultural & Pastoral Occupations
nodes.description: Obsolete occupations of pre-mechanized farming, herding and rural extraction.

nodes.name: Reaper
nodes.description: Cut grain by hand with a sickle or scythe.

nodes.name: Scythesman
nodes.description: Mowed hay and grain with a long scythe.

nodes.name: Sheaf Binder
nodes.description: Gathered and bound cut grain into sheaves.

nodes.name: Thresher
nodes.description: Separated grain from stalks by flailing or treading.

nodes.name: Winnower
nodes.description: Tossed threshed grain to separate chaff in the wind.

nodes.name: Gleaner
nodes.description: Gathered leftover grain from harvested fields.

nodes.name: Ploughman
nodes.description: Guided a horse- or ox-drawn plough.

nodes.name: Haymaker
nodes.description: Cut, turned and stacked hay for winter fodder.

nodes.name: Shepherd
nodes.description: Tended grazing sheep and led them between pastures.

nodes.name: Swineherd
nodes.description: Herded pigs to woodland mast for foraging.

nodes.name: Cowherd
nodes.description: Tended and drove cattle.

nodes.name: Goatherd
nodes.description: Tended grazing goats.

nodes.name: Oxherd
nodes.description: Drove and yoked oxen for ploughing.

nodes.name: Turf Cutter
nodes.description: Cut peat or turf for fuel.

nodes.name: Charcoal Burner
nodes.description: Slow-burned wood in a kiln to make charcoal.

nodes.name: Fur Trapper
nodes.description: Trapped wild animals for the fur trade.

nodes.name: Historical Healing & Body Occupations
nodes.description: Obsolete occupations of folk medicine, surgery and bodily care.

nodes.name: Barber-Surgeon
nodes.description: Cut hair, pulled teeth and performed surgery before the professions separated.

nodes.name: Apothecary
nodes.description: Compounded and sold medicines and simples.

nodes.name: Leech
nodes.description: A folk healer who practised bloodletting, named for the leech.

nodes.name: Leech Collector
nodes.description: Gathered medicinal leeches from ponds for sale to physicians.

nodes.name: Bonesetter
nodes.description: Set fractures and dislocations by manipulation.

nodes.name: Tooth Drawer
nodes.description: Extracted aching teeth at fairs and markets.

nodes.name: Plague Doctor
nodes.description: Treated plague victims wearing a beaked, herb-filled mask.

nodes.name: Midwife
nodes.description: Attended childbirth.

nodes.name: Herbalist
nodes.description: Gathered and dispensed medicinal herbs.

nodes.name: Bath Attendant
nodes.description: Served bathers at public bathhouses or hammams.

nodes.name: Proto-Scientific & Occult Occupations
nodes.description: Obsolete occupations of speculative natural philosophy, divination and pseudoscience.

nodes.name: Alchemist
nodes.description: Sought transmutation and the philosopher's stone through proto-chemical practice.

nodes.name: Astrologer
nodes.description: Cast horoscopes and predicted events from the stars.

nodes.name: Augur
nodes.description: Interpreted the will of the gods from the flight of birds.

nodes.name: Haruspex
nodes.description: Read entrails of sacrificed animals to foretell outcomes.

nodes.name: Oracle
nodes.description: Delivered divine prophecies at a sacred shrine.

nodes.name: Diviner
nodes.description: Found water, minerals or answers by ritual means.

nodes.name: Dowser
nodes.description: Located underground water with a divining rod.

nodes.name: Necromancer
nodes.description: Purported to summon and question the dead.

nodes.name: Phrenologist
nodes.description: Read character from the shape and bumps of the skull.

nodes.name: Almanac Maker
nodes.description: Compiled calendars, weather and astrological predictions.

nodes.name: Religious & Ritual Occupations
nodes.description: Obsolete occupations of priesthood, ritual and sacred service.

nodes.name: Vestal Virgin
nodes.description: A priestess of Vesta who tended Rome's sacred hearth fire.

nodes.name: Temple Priest
nodes.description: Performed sacrifices and rites at an ancient temple.

nodes.name: Hierophant
nodes.description: Revealed sacred mysteries at Eleusis.

nodes.name: Druid
nodes.description: A Celtic priest, judge and keeper of lore.

nodes.name: Anchorite
nodes.description: A recluse enclosed in a cell attached to a church for a life of prayer.

nodes.name: Sin Eater
nodes.description: Ritually consumed food over a corpse to absorb its sins.

nodes.name: Pardoner
nodes.description: Sold indulgences and relics in the medieval church.

nodes.name: Exorcist
nodes.description: Performed rituals to cast out spirits.

nodes.name: Entertainment & Performance Occupations
nodes.description: Obsolete occupations of court, street and arena entertainment.

nodes.name: Court Jester
nodes.description: Amused the court with wit, mockery and foolery.

nodes.name: Minstrel
nodes.description: A travelling medieval entertainer and musician.

nodes.name: Troubadour
nodes.description: A poet-composer of courtly love songs in Occitania.

nodes.name: Jongleur
nodes.description: A wandering entertainer combining music, juggling and recitation.

nodes.name: Bard
nodes.description: A Celtic poet-singer who preserved genealogies and history.

nodes.name: Gleeman
nodes.description: An Anglo-Saxon itinerant entertainer and reciter.

nodes.name: Court Musician
nodes.description: Performed and composed music for a royal court.

nodes.name: Town Wait
nodes.description: A civic musician who played for the town and night watch.

nodes.name: Mummer
nodes.description: Performed masked folk plays at festivals.

nodes.name: Organ Grinder
nodes.description: Played a barrel organ in the street for coins.

nodes.name: Dancing Bear Handler
nodes.description: Trained and exhibited dancing bears.

nodes.name: Gladiator
nodes.description: Fought armed combat in Roman arenas for public spectacle.

nodes.name: Charioteer
nodes.description: Raced horse-drawn chariots in ancient circuses.

nodes.name: Bull Leaper
nodes.description: Vaulted over charging bulls in Minoan ritual sport.

nodes.name: Lighting & Urban Services Occupations
nodes.description: Obsolete occupations of lighting, waking, cleaning and scavenging the pre-modern city.

nodes.name: Lamplighter
nodes.description: Lit and extinguished street gas lamps at dusk and dawn.

nodes.name: Link Boy
nodes.description: Carried a flaming torch to light pedestrians through dark streets.

nodes.name: Knocker-Up
nodes.description: Woke workers by tapping on windows with a long pole.

nodes.name: Night Watchman
nodes.description: Patrolled and guarded a town or premises by night.

nodes.name: Gong Farmer
nodes.description: Cleaned out privies and cesspits by night.

nodes.name: Night Soil Collector
nodes.description: Collected human waste for use as fertiliser.

nodes.name: Rat Catcher
nodes.description: Caught and killed rats, often with terriers and ferrets.

nodes.name: Chimney Sweep
nodes.description: Climbed and swept soot from chimneys.

nodes.name: Crossing Sweeper
nodes.description: Swept a path across muddy streets for pedestrians for tips.

nodes.name: Shoeblack
nodes.description: Polished boots and shoes on the street.

nodes.name: Mudlark
nodes.description: Scavenged the Thames foreshore for salvage.

nodes.name: Tosher
nodes.description: Searched Victorian sewers for coins and valuables.

nodes.name: Dustman
nodes.description: Collected household ash and refuse by cart.

nodes.name: Pre-Modern Military Occupations
nodes.description: Obsolete military roles of the age of bow, pike and edged weapons.

nodes.name: Archer
nodes.description: A soldier who fought with bow and arrows.

nodes.name: Longbowman
nodes.description: A soldier armed with the English longbow.

nodes.name: Crossbowman
nodes.description: A soldier armed with the crossbow.

nodes.name: Pikeman
nodes.description: A foot soldier armed with a long pike.

nodes.name: Musketeer
nodes.description: A soldier armed with a matchlock musket.

nodes.name: Arquebusier
nodes.description: A soldier armed with the early arquebus.

nodes.name: Cuirassier
nodes.description: A heavy cavalryman in breastplate armour.

nodes.name: Cataphract
nodes.description: A heavily armoured cavalryman of antiquity.

nodes.name: Knight
nodes.description: A mounted armoured warrior of the feudal nobility.

nodes.name: Samurai
nodes.description: A member of the Japanese warrior class.

nodes.name: Man-at-Arms
nodes.description: A heavily armed professional medieval soldier.

nodes.name: Cannon Founder
nodes.description: Cast bronze and iron cannon.

nodes.name: Standard Bearer
nodes.description: Carried the unit's banner into battle.

nodes.name: Administrative & Clerical Occupations
nodes.description: Obsolete occupations of record-keeping, revenue and civic administration.

nodes.name: Tally Clerk
nodes.description: Kept accounts on notched wooden tally sticks.

nodes.name: Copying Clerk
nodes.description: Hand-copied letters and ledgers in offices.

nodes.name: Court Clerk
nodes.description: Recorded proceedings and drafted orders for a court.

nodes.name: Lictor
nodes.description: An attendant who escorted Roman magistrates carrying fasces.

nodes.name: Beadle
nodes.description: A parish or university officer who kept order and made proclamations.

nodes.name: Tax Farmer
nodes.description: Bought the right to collect taxes and profited from the yield.

nodes.name: Exciseman
nodes.description: Collected excise duties on goods and inspected for smuggling.

nodes.name: Gatekeeper
nodes.description: Controlled entry at a castle or city gate.

nodes.name: Summoner
nodes.description: Served summonses to appear before an ecclesiastical court.

nodes.name: Quipu Keeper
nodes.description: Recorded Inca accounts on knotted cords (quipu).

nodes.name: Imperial Examiner
nodes.description: Graded candidates in the imperial civil-service examinations.

nodes.name: Industrial Era Obsolete Occupations
nodes.description: Obsolete occupations of the early industrial mills, mines and manual machinery.

nodes.name: Mule Spinner
nodes.description: Operated the spinning mule in cotton mills.

nodes.name: Power Loom Weaver
nodes.description: Tended power looms in textile mills.

nodes.name: Carder
nodes.description: Prepared fibres by carding before spinning.

nodes.name: Piecer
nodes.description: A child who joined broken threads in spinning mills.

nodes.name: Doffer
nodes.description: Removed full bobbins from spinning frames, often a child.

nodes.name: Mill Scavenger
nodes.description: A child who crawled under machines to clear waste.

nodes.name: Breaker Boy
nodes.description: A boy who sorted impurities from coal at the breaker.

nodes.name: Hurrier
nodes.description: A child who hauled coal tubs through mine tunnels.

nodes.name: Mine Trapper
nodes.description: A child who opened and closed mine ventilation doors.

nodes.name: Navvy
nodes.description: A labourer who built canals, railways and roads.

nodes.name: Stoker
nodes.description: Fed coal into steam-engine and ship boilers.

nodes.name: Match Girl
nodes.description: Dipped matches, often suffering phosphorus poisoning.

nodes.name: Pin Boy
nodes.description: Reset bowling pins by hand between frames.

nodes.name: Elevator Operator
nodes.description: Drove a manual lever elevator and announced floors.

nodes.name: Computing, Film & Reproduction Occupations
nodes.description: Obsolete occupations of manual computation, data entry and photographic reproduction.

nodes.name: Human Computer
nodes.description: Performed mathematical calculations by hand or with tables.

nodes.description: A husband who resides with and joins his wife's family line, as in Chinese ruzhui marriage.

nodes.name: Parent
nodes.description: A person who raises or begets a child and bears parental responsibility.

nodes.name: Father
nodes.description: A male parent.

nodes.name: Mother
nodes.description: A female parent.

nodes.name: Stepfather
nodes.description: The husband of one's parent who is not one's biological or adoptive father.

nodes.name: Stepmother
nodes.description: The wife of one's parent who is not one's biological or adoptive mother.

nodes.name: Adoptive Parent
nodes.description: A parent who legally adopts a child not biologically their own.

nodes.name: Foster Parent
nodes.description: An adult who temporarily cares for a child placed by an agency or kin network.

nodes.name: Guardian
nodes.description: A person with legal authority and duty to care for a minor or dependent.

nodes.name: Grandparent
nodes.description: A parent of one's parent.

nodes.name: Grandfather
nodes.description: The father of one's parent.

nodes.name: Grandmother
nodes.description: The mother of one's parent.

nodes.name: Child (Kinship)
nodes.description: A son or daughter considered in relation to their parents.

nodes.name: Son
nodes.description: A male child in relation to his parents.

nodes.name: Daughter
nodes.description: A female child in relation to her parents.

nodes.name: Adopted Child
nodes.description: A child legally raised by parents who are not their biological parents.

nodes.name: Child Bride
nodes.description: A girl married before adulthood, historically practiced in many societies.

nodes.name: Sibling
nodes.description: A brother or sister sharing one or both parents.

nodes.name: Brother
nodes.description: A male sibling.

nodes.name: Sister
nodes.description: A female sibling.

nodes.name: Extended Kin
nodes.description: Relatives beyond the nuclear family, linked by blood or marriage.

nodes.name: Aunt
nodes.description: The sister of one's parent or the wife of one's uncle.

nodes.name: Uncle
nodes.description: The brother of one's parent or the husband of one's aunt.

nodes.name: Cousin
nodes.description: The child of one's aunt or uncle.

nodes.name: Nephew
nodes.description: The son of one's sibling.

nodes.name: Niece
nodes.description: The daughter of one's sibling.

nodes.name: In-Law
nodes.description: A relative acquired through marriage rather than blood.

nodes.name: Mother-in-Law
nodes.description: The mother of one's spouse.

nodes.name: Father-in-Law
nodes.description: The father of one's spouse.

nodes.name: Son-in-Law
nodes.description: The husband of one's daughter.

nodes.name: Daughter-in-Law
nodes.description: The wife of one's son.

nodes.name: Co-Sibling-in-Law
nodes.description: The spouse of one's spouse's sibling, as in Chinese zhouli or lianjin.

nodes.name: Lineage & Ancestry Roles
nodes.description: Roles defined by descent, ancestry, and inheritance within a family line.

nodes.name: Matriarch
nodes.description: A woman who heads and holds authority over a family or lineage.

nodes.name: Patriarch
nodes.description: A man who heads and holds authority over a family or lineage.

nodes.name: Ancestor
nodes.description: A forebear from whom a family line descends, often venerated.

nodes.name: Descendant
nodes.description: A person who descends from a particular ancestor.

nodes.name: Heir
nodes.description: A person entitled to inherit a family's property, title, or position.

nodes.name: Family Elder
nodes.description: A senior family member whose age confers respect and advisory authority.

nodes.name: Fictive Kinship Roles
nodes.description: Chosen kin relations modeled on family bonds without blood or marriage ties.

nodes.name: Godparent
nodes.description: A sponsor of a child's religious initiation who assumes a mentoring kinship role.

nodes.name: Compadre
nodes.description: A co-parent bound by godparenthood, a central kinship bond in Latin America.

nodes.name: Blood Brother
nodes.description: A non-kin male bound by a sworn oath or blood ritual of brotherhood.

nodes.name: Wet Nurse
nodes.description: A woman who breastfeeds and nurtures another woman's child, often as a long-term bond.

nodes.name: Milk Sibling
nodes.description: An unrelated person who shared the same wet nurse, creating a recognized kin-like bond.

nodes.name: Community & Civil Roles
nodes.description: Roles people occupy in neighborhoods, voluntary associations, and civil society.

nodes.name: Community Membership Roles
nodes.description: Roles defined by a person's standing or belonging within a locality.

nodes.name: Resident
nodes.description: A person who lives in a particular place.

nodes.name: Newcomer
nodes.description: A person newly arrived in a community.

nodes.name: Local
nodes.description: A long-established member of a place, contrasted with outsiders.

nodes.name: Migrant
nodes.description: A person who moves within or across regions to live and work.

nodes.name: Refugee
nodes.description: A person forced to flee their country by war, persecution, or disaster.

nodes.name: Exile
nodes.description: A person barred from their homeland, usually for political reasons.

nodes.name: Neighbor
nodes.description: A person living near another, with mutual local obligations.

nodes.name: Host
nodes.description: A person who receives and provides for guests.

nodes.name: Guest
nodes.description: A person received and entertained in another's home or community.

nodes.name: Community Leadership Roles
nodes.description: Roles involving guiding, representing, or organizing a local community.

nodes.name: Community Leader
nodes.description: A person recognized as a guide and representative of a community.

nodes.name: Community Elder
nodes.description: A senior member whose experience gives them advisory standing.

nodes.name: Community Organizer
nodes.description: A person who mobilizes residents around shared goals and collective action.

nodes.name: Block Captain
nodes.description: A volunteer who represents and coordinates a city block or building.

nodes.name: Neighborhood Committee Member
nodes.description: An elected or appointed member of a residents' committee governing a district.

nodes.name: Volunteer & Advocacy Roles
nodes.description: Roles involving unpaid service, giving, and public advocacy.

nodes.name: Volunteer
nodes.description: A person who gives time and labor to a cause without pay.

nodes.name: Philanthropist
nodes.description: A person who donates wealth and resources to promote human welfare.

nodes.name: Patron
nodes.description: A supporter who funds and champions a person, cause, or institution.

nodes.name: Activist
nodes.description: A person who campaigns to bring about social or political change.

nodes.name: Advocate
nodes.description: A person who publicly supports and argues for a cause or group.

nodes.name: Whistleblower
nodes.description: A person who exposes wrongdoing within an organization to the public.

nodes.name: Donor
nodes.description: A person who gives money, blood, organs, or goods to help others.

nodes.name: Dispute Resolution Roles
nodes.description: Roles involving settling conflicts and restoring harmony within a community.

nodes.name: Mediator
nodes.description: A neutral person who helps disputing parties reach an agreement.

nodes.name: Peacemaker
nodes.description: A person who works to end conflict and reconcile opposing parties.

nodes.name: Political & Civic Roles
nodes.description: Roles in governance, rule, representation, and the political life of a state.

nodes.name: Citizen & Elector Roles
nodes.description: Roles tied to membership and participation in a political community.

nodes.name: Citizen
nodes.description: A legally recognized member of a state with rights and duties.

nodes.name: Voter
nodes.description: A person who casts a ballot in an election or referendum.

nodes.name: Constituent
nodes.description: A citizen represented by an elected official.

nodes.name: Monarch & Dynastic Roles
nodes.description: Hereditary ruling roles of kings, queens, and imperial dynasties.

nodes.name: Monarch
nodes.description: A hereditary sovereign ruler such as a king or queen.

nodes.name: Emperor
nodes.description: The sovereign of an empire, ranking above a king.

nodes.name: Empress
nodes.description: A female sovereign of an empire or the wife of an emperor.

nodes.name: King
nodes.description: A male monarch ruling a kingdom.

nodes.name: Queen
nodes.description: A female monarch or the wife of a king.

nodes.name: Prince
nodes.description: A male member of a royal family or ruler of a principality.

nodes.name: Princess
nodes.description: A female member of a royal family.

nodes.name: Regent
nodes.description: A person who governs during a monarch's minority or incapacity.

nodes.name: Heir Apparent
nodes.description: The person first in line to inherit a throne.

nodes.name: Nobility & Aristocracy
nodes.description: Hereditary or titled ranks of a privileged ruling class.

nodes.name: Noble
nodes.description: A member of a hereditary privileged social class.

nodes.name: Duke
nodes.description: A nobleman of the highest rank below the monarch.

nodes.name: Count
nodes.description: A European nobleman ranking below a duke.

nodes.name: Baron
nodes.description: A nobleman of the lowest hereditary rank.

nodes.name: Knight
nodes.description: A person granted a non-hereditary title for service, historically a mounted warrior.

nodes.name: Peer
nodes.description: A holder of a title conferring membership in a hereditary or appointed upper house.

nodes.name: Executive & Administrative Roles
nodes.description: Roles that head or administer the government of a state.

nodes.name: Head of State
nodes.description: The chief public representative of a state, ceremonial or executive.

nodes.name: Head of Government
nodes.description: The chief executive officer who leads a government's administration.

nodes.name: President
nodes.description: An elected or appointed head of state or republic.

nodes.name: Prime Minister
nodes.description: The head of government in a parliamentary system.

nodes.name: Governor
nodes.description: The elected or appointed head of a province, state, or territory.

nodes.name: Mayor
nodes.description: The elected head of a city or municipal government.

nodes.name: Minister
nodes.description: A senior government member heading a ministry or department.

nodes.name: Civil Servant
nodes.description: A career employee of the state's administrative bureaucracy.

nodes.name: Legislative Roles
nodes.description: Roles involving lawmaking and representation in an assembly.

nodes.name: Legislator
nodes.description: A member of a body that makes laws.

nodes.name: Senator
nodes.description: A member of a senate or upper legislative chamber.

nodes.name: Member of Parliament
nodes.description: An elected representative in a parliamentary legislature.

nodes.name: Councilor
nodes.description: An elected member of a local or municipal council.

nodes.name: Speaker
nodes.description: The presiding officer of a legislative assembly.

nodes.name: Party Whip
nodes.description: A legislator who enforces party discipline and manages voting.

nodes.name: Tribune
nodes.description: An elected plebeian magistrate in ancient Rome empowered to protect citizens.

nodes.name: Diplomatic Roles
nodes.description: Roles representing a state in relations with other states.

nodes.name: Diplomat
nodes.description: An official who conducts a state's foreign relations.

nodes.name: Ambassador
nodes.description: The highest-ranking envoy representing a state in another country.

nodes.name: Envoy
nodes.description: A diplomatic representative sent on a specific mission.

nodes.name: Consul
nodes.description: An official protecting a state's citizens and commercial interests abroad.

nodes.name: Party & Movement Roles
nodes.description: Roles within political parties and social movements.

nodes.name: Party Leader
nodes.description: The head of a political party.

nodes.name: Opposition Leader
nodes.description: The leader of the largest party not in government.

nodes.name: Party Member
nodes.description: A dues-paying member of a political party.

nodes.name: Candidate
nodes.description: A person standing for election to public office.

nodes.name: Non-Western & Historical Rulership
nodes.name_zh: 非西方与历史统治角色
nodes.description: Sovereign and high-official roles of non-Western and past polities.

nodes.name: Sultan
nodes.description: A Muslim sovereign ruler, especially of an Ottoman or Malay state.

nodes.name: Caliph
nodes.description: The successor ruler of the early Muslim community and a politico-religious sovereign.

nodes.name: Emir
nodes.description: A Muslim prince, commander, or ruler of an emirate.

nodes.name: Khan
nodes.description: A Mongol or Turkic sovereign or chief.

nodes.name: Pharaoh
nodes.description: The divine king of ancient Egypt.

nodes.name: Maharaja
nodes.description: A great king or high-ranking Hindu or Sikh prince in South Asia.

nodes.name: Shogun
nodes.description: The hereditary military dictator who ruled Japan on the emperor's behalf.

nodes.name: Daimyo
nodes.description: A feudal territorial lord in pre-modern Japan.

nodes.name: Vizier
nodes.description: A high-ranking minister or chief advisor in Muslim and Ottoman courts.

nodes.name: Mandarin
nodes.description: A scholar-official of imperial China appointed through the examination system.

nodes.name: Tsar
nodes.description: The emperor of Russia or a Slavic imperial sovereign.

nodes.name: Legal & Judicial Roles
nodes.description: Roles in courts, legal advocacy, adjudication, and the justice system.

nodes.name: Judicial Roles
nodes.description: Roles that adjudicate disputes and interpret law.

nodes.name: Judge
nodes.description: An official who presides over a court and decides cases.

nodes.name: Justice
nodes.description: A judge of a supreme or high court.

nodes.name: Chief Justice
nodes.description: The presiding judge of a supreme court.

nodes.name: Judicial Magistrate
nodes.description: A lower-court judge handling minor criminal and civil matters.

nodes.name: Lay Judge
nodes.description: A citizen who sits alongside professional judges to decide cases.

nodes.name: Qadi
nodes.description: A judge who applies Islamic law in a sharia court.

nodes.name: Legal Advocacy Roles
nodes.description: Roles representing parties' interests in legal proceedings.

nodes.name: Lawyer
nodes.description: A person licensed to advise on and represent clients in legal matters.

nodes.name: Barrister
nodes.description: A lawyer who pleads cases in higher courts, especially in common-law systems.

nodes.name: Solicitor
nodes.description: A lawyer who advises clients and prepares cases, traditionally without higher-court advocacy.

nodes.name: Prosecutor
nodes.description: A lawyer who brings criminal charges on behalf of the state.

nodes.name: Public Defender
nodes.description: A state-appointed lawyer representing defendants who cannot afford counsel.

nodes.name: Jury Roles
nodes.description: Roles of lay citizens who decide facts in a trial.

nodes.name: Juror
nodes.description: A citizen sworn to render a verdict in a trial.

nodes.name: Jury Foreperson
nodes.description: The juror who presides over deliberations and announces the verdict.

nodes.name: Grand Juror
nodes.description: A juror on a panel that decides whether to issue indictments.

nodes.name: Court & Registry Officials
nodes.description: Roles that administer courts and authenticate legal documents.

nodes.name: Bailiff
nodes.description: A court officer who keeps order and carries out the court's commands.

nodes.name: Court Clerk
nodes.description: An official who keeps court records and administers proceedings.

nodes.name: Notary
nodes.description: An official who witnesses and authenticates legal documents and signatures.

nodes.name: Registrar
nodes.description: An official who maintains civil records of births, marriages, and deaths.

nodes.name: Coroner
nodes.description: An official who investigates deaths and determines their cause.

nodes.name: Litigant & Witness Roles
nodes.name_zh: 诉讼当事人与证人角色
nodes.description: Roles of parties and evidence-givers in legal proceedings.

nodes.name: Plaintiff
nodes.description: The party who brings a civil lawsuit.

nodes.name: Defendant
nodes.description: The party accused or sued in a legal proceeding.

nodes.name: Witness
nodes.description: A person who gives evidence about facts in a case.

nodes.name: Expert Witness
nodes.description: A specialist who provides technical or scientific testimony.

nodes.name: Alternative Dispute Resolution Roles
nodes.description: Roles that resolve disputes outside formal court litigation.

nodes.name: Arbitrator (Legal)
nodes.description: A neutral person empowered to resolve a dispute by binding decision.

nodes.name: Mediator (Legal)
nodes.description: A neutral facilitator who helps parties negotiate a voluntary settlement.

nodes.name: Religious & Spiritual Roles
nodes.description: Roles in organized religion, monastic life, and indigenous spiritual practice.

nodes.name: Clergy
nodes.description: Ordained officials who lead worship and administer sacraments.

nodes.name: Priest
nodes.description: An ordained minister authorized to perform sacred rites.

nodes.name: Pastor
nodes.description: A clergyperson who shepherds and preaches to a congregation.

nodes.name: Chaplain
nodes.description: A clergyperson serving a secular institution such as a hospital, prison, or army.

nodes.name: Bishop
nodes.description: A senior clergyperson who oversees a diocese.

nodes.name: Archbishop
nodes.description: A bishop of the highest rank who leads an ecclesiastical province.

nodes.name: Cardinal
nodes.description: A high Catholic prelate who elects the pope.

nodes.name: Pope
nodes.description: The bishop of Rome and supreme head of the Roman Catholic Church.

nodes.name: Deacon
nodes.description: An ordained minister ranking below a priest.

nodes.name: Church Patriarch
nodes.description: A leading bishop in Eastern Orthodox and Oriental churches.

nodes.name: Monastic & Ascetic Roles
nodes.description: Roles of those who withdraw from secular life for spiritual discipline.

nodes.name: Monk
nodes.description: A man who lives under religious vows in a monastery.

nodes.name: Nun
nodes.description: A woman who lives under religious vows in a convent.

nodes.name: Friar
nodes.description: A mendicant monk of an order that serves the wider community.

nodes.name: Abbot
nodes.description: The head of a monastery.

nodes.name: Novice
nodes.description: A person in a probationary period before taking religious vows.

nodes.name: Hermit
nodes.description: A person who lives in solitude for religious devotion.

nodes.name: Bhikkhu
nodes.description: A fully ordained Buddhist monk in the Theravada tradition.

nodes.name: Bhikkhuni
nodes.description: A fully ordained Buddhist nun in the Theravada tradition.

nodes.name: Lama
nodes.description: A Tibetan Buddhist teacher or senior monk.

nodes.name: Swami
nodes.description: A Hindu ascetic or religious teacher who has renounced worldly life.

nodes.name: Sadhu
nodes.description: A wandering Hindu holy person devoted to spiritual practice.

nodes.name: Fakir
nodes.description: A Muslim or Hindu ascetic who lives on alms, often a wandering mystic.

nodes.name: Islamic Religious Roles
nodes.description: Religious offices and leadership roles within Islam.

nodes.name: Imam
nodes.description: A Muslim who leads congregational prayer and often guides a community.

nodes.name: Mufti
nodes.description: A Muslim jurist qualified to issue legal opinions (fatwas).

nodes.name: Ayatollah
nodes.description: A high-ranking Shi'a religious authority and jurist.

nodes.name: Sheikh
nodes.description: A respected Muslim elder, scholar, or spiritual leader.

nodes.name: Muezzin
nodes.description: The person who calls Muslims to prayer from a mosque.

nodes.name: Hafiz
nodes.description: A Muslim who has memorized the entire Quran.

nodes.name: Dervish
nodes.description: A member of a Sufi order practicing poverty and mystical devotion.

nodes.name: Pir
nodes.description: A Sufi spiritual master and guide.

nodes.name: Jewish Religious Roles
nodes.description: Religious offices and ritual roles within Judaism.

nodes.name: Rabbi
nodes.description: A Jewish scholar and teacher qualified to decide religious law.

nodes.name: Hazzan
nodes.description: A synagogue cantor who leads liturgical chanting.

nodes.name: Mohel
nodes.description: A person trained to perform the Jewish ritual of circumcision.

nodes.name: Kohen
nodes.description: A Jew of priestly descent who performs certain synagogue blessings.

nodes.name: Rebbe
nodes.description: The spiritual leader of a Hasidic dynasty.

nodes.name: Sofer
nodes.description: A scribe who writes Torah scrolls and sacred texts.

nodes.name: East & South Asian Religious Roles
nodes.description: Spiritual teachers and ritual specialists of Hindu, Buddhist, and Taoist traditions.

nodes.name: Guru
nodes.description: A Hindu, Sikh, or spiritual teacher who transmits knowledge to disciples.

nodes.name: Yogi
nodes.description: A practitioner of yoga who has attained spiritual mastery.

nodes.name: Sannyasi
nodes.description: A Hindu who has renounced worldly life in the final stage of life.

nodes.name: Rōshi
nodes.description: A venerated Zen Buddhist master and teacher.

nodes.name: Daoshi
nodes.description: An ordained Taoist priest who performs rituals and liturgy.

nodes.name: Fangshi
nodes.description: A ritual master and diviner in Chinese folk and Taoist practice.

nodes.name: Rinpoche
nodes.description: An honored reincarnate lama in Tibetan Buddhism.

nodes.name: Tulku
nodes.description: A recognized reincarnation of a previous Buddhist master.

nodes.name: Indigenous & Folk Religious Roles
nodes.name_zh: 原住民与民间宗教角色
nodes.description: Spiritual specialists of indigenous, folk, and animist traditions.

nodes.name: Shaman
nodes.description: A practitioner who enters altered states to mediate with the spirit world.

nodes.name: Medicine Person
nodes.description: An indigenous healer who uses ritual, plants, and spiritual knowledge.

nodes.name: Curandero
nodes.description: A Latin American folk healer combining Catholic and indigenous practice.

nodes.name: Babalawo
nodes.description: A Yoruba Ifá divination priest.

nodes.name: Sangoma
nodes.description: A southern African diviner and healer who communicates with ancestors.

nodes.name: Diviner
nodes.description: A specialist who foretells events and reads omens through ritual methods.

nodes.name: Spirit Medium
nodes.description: A person who is possessed by spirits to convey messages to the living.

nodes.name: Druid
nodes.description: A priest and learned class of the ancient Celtic peoples.

nodes.name: Houngan
nodes.description: A male Vodou priest in Haiti.

nodes.name: Mambo
nodes.description: A female Vodou priestess in Haiti.

nodes.name: Lay Religious Roles
nodes.description: Non-ordained roles of service and leadership within religious communities.

nodes.name: Layperson
nodes.description: A non-ordained member of a religious community.

nodes.name: Altar Server
nodes.description: A lay person, often a youth, who assists the clergy during services.

nodes.name: Lector
nodes.description: A lay person who reads scripture aloud during worship.

nodes.name: Catechist
nodes.description: A lay teacher of religious doctrine to converts and children.

nodes.name: Missionary
nodes.description: A person sent to spread a religion and serve in another community.

nodes.name: Evangelist
nodes.description: A person who preaches the gospel to convert others.

nodes.name: Preacher
nodes.description: A person who delivers sermons, often without formal ordination.

nodes.name: Ceremonial & Ritual Roles
nodes.description: Roles in weddings, funerals, festivals, and other rites of passage.

nodes.name: Officiant Roles
nodes.description: Roles that lead or preside over ceremonies.

nodes.name: Celebrant
nodes.description: A person who performs a rite, especially a marriage or memorial.

nodes.name: Master of Ceremonies
nodes.description: A host who introduces and guides the events of a ceremony or banquet.

nodes.name: Wedding Party Roles
nodes.description: Supporting roles in a wedding ceremony and celebration.

nodes.name: Best Man
nodes.description: The groom's principal male attendant and witness.

nodes.name: Maid of Honor
nodes.description: The bride's principal female attendant.

nodes.name: Bridesmaid
nodes.description: A female attendant who supports the bride.

nodes.name: Groomsman
nodes.description: A male attendant who supports the groom.

nodes.name: Flower Girl
nodes.description: A young girl who scatters petals before the bride.

nodes.name: Matchmaker
nodes.description: A person who arranges introductions and marriages between families.

nodes.name: Nakodo
nodes.description: A Japanese go-between who arranges marriages and mediates between families.

nodes.name: Funeral & Mourning Roles
nodes.description: Roles in death rites and the expression of mourning.

nodes.name: Pallbearer
nodes.description: A person who carries or escorts a coffin at a funeral.

nodes.name: Eulogist
nodes.description: A person who delivers a speech praising the deceased.

nodes.name: Mourner
nodes.description: A person who grieves and participates in funeral rites.

nodes.name: Chief Mourner
nodes.description: The principal relative who leads mourning and funeral duties.

nodes.name: Festival & Pageant Roles
nodes.description: Roles in seasonal festivals, carnivals, and public pageants.

nodes.name: Carnival King
nodes.description: A figurehead who presides over a carnival celebration.

nodes.name: Festival Queen
nodes.description: A young woman crowned to preside over a local festival.

nodes.name: Masquerader
nodes.description: A performer who wears a mask and costume in carnival or masquerade.

nodes.name: Gender Roles
nodes.description: Social roles assigned to or associated with gender identities.

nodes.name: Binary Gender Roles
nodes.description: Roles tied to the traditional male/female gender binary.

nodes.name: Man
nodes.description: The adult male gender role in a society.

nodes.name: Woman
nodes.description: The adult female gender role in a society.

nodes.name: Bachelor
nodes.description: An unmarried man, especially one past the usual marrying age.

nodes.name: Spinster
nodes.description: An unmarried woman past the usual marrying age, historically stigmatized.

nodes.name: Housewife
nodes.description: A woman whose primary role is managing a household and family.

nodes.name: Househusband
nodes.description: A man whose primary role is managing a household and family.

nodes.name: Third-Gender & Gender-Variant Roles
nodes.name_zh: 第三性与性别多元角色
nodes.description: Culturally recognized roles beyond the male/female binary.

nodes.name: Hijra
nodes.description: A South Asian third-gender community with its own social and ritual roles.

nodes.name: Two-Spirit
nodes.description: An Indigenous North American person embodying both masculine and feminine roles.

nodes.name: Fa'afafine
nodes.description: A Samoan person assigned male at birth who lives a feminine social role.

nodes.name: Kathoey
nodes.description: A Thai transgender or third-gender woman.

nodes.name: Muxe
nodes.description: A Zapotec person assigned male at birth who occupies a distinct third-gender role.

nodes.name: Sworn Virgin
nodes.description: An Albanian woman who takes a vow of chastity and lives as a man.

nodes.name: Wakashu
nodes.description: A pre-adult male in Edo-period Japan occupying a distinct aesthetic-gender role.

nodes.name: Age-Graded & Life-Stage Roles
nodes.description: Roles defined by a person's age or stage in the life course.

nodes.name: Childhood & Youth Roles
nodes.description: Age roles of infancy through youth.

nodes.name: Infant
nodes.description: A child in the first year of life.

nodes.name: Toddler
nodes.description: A young child learning to walk, roughly one to three years old.

nodes.name: Child (Age)
nodes.description: A person between infancy and adolescence.

nodes.name: Adolescent
nodes.description: A person in the transitional stage between childhood and adulthood.

nodes.name: Youth
nodes.description: A young person, especially one in the transition to adult roles.

nodes.name: Adult & Senior Roles
nodes.description: Age roles from adulthood through old age.

nodes.name: Young Adult
nodes.description: A person in early adulthood, roughly twenties to thirties.

nodes.name: Adult
nodes.description: A person who has reached the age of majority.

nodes.name: Senior Citizen
nodes.description: An older person, typically past retirement age.

nodes.name: Elder
nodes.description: An older person whose age confers respect and advisory status.

nodes.name: Retiree
nodes.description: A person who has withdrawn from paid work.

nodes.name: Coming-of-Age Roles
nodes.description: Roles marking the transition to adult status through ritual.

nodes.name: Initiate
nodes.description: A person undergoing a rite of passage into a new status.

nodes.name: Debutante
nodes.description: A young woman formally introduced to adult society.

nodes.name: Quinceañera
nodes.description: A Latin American girl celebrating her fifteenth-birthday coming of age.

nodes.name: Seijin-shiki Adult
nodes.description: A Japanese young person recognized as an adult at the coming-of-age ceremony.

nodes.name: Life-Transition Roles
nodes.description: Roles defined by major transitions in the life course.

nodes.name: Newlywed
nodes.description: A person recently married.

nodes.name: Expectant Parent
nodes.description: A person expecting the birth of a child.

nodes.name: Empty Nester
nodes.description: A parent whose children have grown and left home.

nodes.name: Clan & Village Roles
nodes.description: Roles of leadership and specialists within clans, villages, and tribes.

nodes.name: Clan Leadership Roles
nodes.description: Roles governing descent groups and clans.

nodes.name: Clan Chief
nodes.description: The hereditary or elected head of a clan.

nodes.name: Lineage Head
nodes.description: The head of a lineage segment, often keeper of ancestral rites.

nodes.name: Clan Mother
nodes.description: A Haudenosaunee woman who selects chiefs and holds clan authority.

nodes.name: Ancestral Shrine Keeper
nodes.description: A person who maintains an ancestral shrine and performs rites.

nodes.name: Village Leadership Roles
nodes.description: Roles governing and representing a village community.

nodes.name: Village Head
nodes.description: The chief or headman of a village.

nodes.name: Village Headwoman
nodes.description: A female head of a village.

nodes.name: Council of Elders Member
